name: Shirmani Heart-View Inspection Protocol
purpose: A consent-based, evidence-aware inspection framework for self-reflection, education, role applications and other explicitly selected purposes.

language.rule: Text interpretation is probabilistic and must expose uncertainty.

reasoning.rule: No AI output is itself proof of truth.

behavioral_observation.rule: Do not infer protected or sensitive traits from behavior.

methods: liveness where legally and technically appropriate
optional_sensing.rule: Raw biometric data must be minimized, protected and never used as a hidden identity or character score.

fairness_rules: Do not rank people as human/non-human.
Do not issue a universal moral-worth score.
Do not make employment, governmental, judicial or civic decisions autonomously.
Every consequential result requires an accountable human or legally authorized process.
A certificate records the stated inspection and evidence state; it is not automatic accreditation.
